This plot is rented, so I will not put my good cow dung here — that goes on my own land where I know I will stay. But I will buy one bag of urea from the cooperative and spread it, because without fertilizer the soil is tired and the crop will be thin, and my neighbor did the same last year and his grain was better. I will plant with seed I kept from my own harvest; I do not buy those new seeds in the package because they cost too much and I do not trust what I cannot see grow first. My wife, my sons, and I will do all the work ourselves — we have no cash to pay workers. We do not spray chemicals on this crop, and there is no water pump here; we only wait for the rain God sends.
